concepts.prompt: Every view shows the complete wall segment from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle: front three-quarter, straight front, and rear three-quarter views. A modular straight stone curtain wall segment for a sky citadel, 22 metres long, 8 metres tall and 3 metres thick, like the bridge arch reference: a thick coursed limestone wall pierced by three large open round arches side by side, all the way through, with carved voussoirs and keystones. On top a walkway with crenellated battlements (square merlons) on the front edge and a low parapet behind. Two royal-blue fabric banners with a white and gold wing emblem hang from gold rods on the piers between the arches, and one gold iron lantern bracket with a warm amber lantern is fixed to the wall. Both ends of the wall are cut perfectly flat and vertical so segments chain end to end; no towers at the ends. Straight, symmetric, modular. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no landscape, no cliffs, no clouds, no sky, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone ashlar (#a89c8a to #c4b8a4, never pure white) in coursed blocks with soft moss in the joints; slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66); gilded gold ribs and accents (#c9a24a); royal-blue fabric banners with a white and gold wing emblem; honey-coloured timber only for doors, balconies and planks; warm amber window glass as a distinct saturated colour. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon, no pink anywhere. No half-timbering, no cream plaster, no thatch. Flat ground contact at the base.
concepts.verdict: rejected: views too short and tall (about 1.4:1, brief 2.75:1), arch openings had raised sills instead of reaching the ground; view 2 had a black background and a second partial object
